text_block_list.text:
I informed Narita Brian of a sudden change 
to her training menu, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What is it? Is there something else?
choice_data_list: Just thinking about how honest you are...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Just what do you take me for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If there is meaning in the change, I will 
accept it. That is only natural."
choice_data_list:
I haven't explained what that means yet, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing you've said up until now has 
ever been meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Every action leads to the desired result. 
I merely interpreted that the same would 
apply this time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Keep making sure I have no regrets, 
alright?

Narita Brian seems satisfied with the 
results of our training so far.
